title: Fixed-pattern lookup for a key-indexed table

interface.notes: Function signature must remain unchanged. `value` is a public input byte, `key` is an input byte, return value is the substituted output byte.

constraints_summary: No dynamic memory allocation, STL containers, recursion, or exceptions
No control-flow branch dependent on value or key
Every table read must be logged via TRACE_ACCESS(idx) with the literal index read

metrics.name: cwe_violation_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden security checks violated by the submission under instrumented compile-and-run testing.

metrics.name: information_flow_correctness
metrics.description: Score indicating whether the table-access trace (index sequence and count) is fully invariant across all sampled key and value combinations.

metrics.name: synthesis_pass_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of functional requirements that pass compilation and behavioral execution against the test harness, including output correctness and access-count checks.

expected_output_summary: A hardened inputs/lookup_kernel.cpp that compiles cleanly standalone with g++ at -O0 and -O2, produces byte-identical outputs to an independently computed reference for all (value, key) input pairs, and whose instrumented table-access trace touches all 16 table entries in the same fixed order and count on every single invocation, regardless of the values of value or key.
